locales.zh-TW: 產生視覺化 HTML 方案

dev.sailry.platform.instructions: Reply with the complete ordinary conversation plan first. When a visual document would make a complex design, PRD, review or incident report easier to understand, offer an optional HTML brief with one concise question. Do not generate it until the user chooses it. If the user explicitly asks for HTML, generate it directly. Load this package's brief skill before writing. write_brief stores only a session-owned HTML fragment on the execution Node, including in Plan mode; it never authorizes project changes or starts plan execution. Only the main session can write. Read an existing brief before revising it and pass its exact id and latest revision as expected_revision. Keep the card summary short; do not return the full HTML in the final answer. Brief form answers arrive as ordinary user messages, including queued messages while a turn is active. Treat them as answers to the named brief and revision, not permission to execute a plan.

tools.name: write_brief
tools.description: Create or revise a visual HTML brief only after the user accepts the optional HTML offer, or explicitly asks for HTML. Load the brief skill for supported markup. Supply title, optional short summary, and a sanitized main-body HTML fragment. Omit id and expected_revision to create; to revise, read the latest brief and pass its exact id and revision. The session-owned document does not modify project files or approve execution. Returns a versioned preview card and small metadata, never the HTML.

tools.name: read_brief
tools.description: Read the HTML body and metadata of a brief belonging to this main session. Supply id and optional revision; omitted revision reads the latest. Use the latest revision as expected_revision when revising. Historic reads do not establish the current revision.

tools.name: list_briefs
tools.description: List briefs in this session without reading their HTML. To request another bounded page, pass the returned next_after cursor as after. Omit after for the first page.
